title: Grand Theft Auto 2/Area 3
text:
__ToC__

Gangs

Krishna

Krishna territory is in the southeast corner of the Industrial District, where they have a Vedic Temple. They loath technology, stealing guns and cars to crush and destroy them to counter their threat to peace and quiet. In Grand Theft Auto, the player is rewarded for running them down, and apparently they're not taking it anymore...

Zaibatsu

Zaibatsu territory is in the southwest quarter of the Industrial District. They're also present in Area 1, and Area 2.

Russian Mafia

Russian Mafia territory is in the north of the Industrial District, particularly its northeast corner. They specialize in smuggling stolen cars, weapons, body parts and organs, as well as contract-killing. They drive s, the only gang vehicles that can survive one direct hit from a  or Molotov Cocktail when in (near) perfect condition.

Weapons
../Weapons/ can always be picked up near every gang phone, and they can spawn again after 15 seconds during play, so you can wait in place until you have maximum 99 ammo.

Most other weapons don't spawn again once picked up.

Final Job!
The final job starts automatically after completing all 21 jobs for the three gangs. You only have one chance to pass this job: if you fail then you can quit and resume saved status to repeat the final gang job(s). For this reason, saving one of the quicker and easier jobs for last is recommended.

If the Bosses aren't in their own territory then they may drive s instead of a gang vehicle. If you don't destroy their vehicles then once they exit two  shots or equivalent damage will kill them, but the bonus for killing each individually is the same as any normal pedestrian.

The Krishna Boss drives a  and he's armed with a Flamethrower, so if you don't have  or  active then it's best to keep him at a distance while using longer-range weapons, or just run over him with a vehicle. If you're burning, you can still pass this job if you're the last to be wasted.

The new Zaibatsu Boss drives a  and he's armed with a , but switches to a Pistol at close range. Unless your vehicle can take more than one rocket, it may be best to exit it (preferably with Invisibility or Invulnerability* active).

The Russian Boss drives a  and he's armed with a :

You earn a $5,000,000 (x Multiplier) bonus, and your Bonus Multiplier increases by 1.

The Industrial District descends into anarchy, but order is restored if you resume saved status after saving and then quitting play.

Area Complete!
Once you have $5,000,000:

If you haven't already done so, then collect all ../Tokens/ and save before leaving the Area to unlock ../Bonus Stages/ G-I (you can also pass all ../Kill Frenzies/).

thumb|Game Complete! (Windows)
From the Area Complete! screen you can now select from the following:

 Resume d Status
 Replay Previous Area
 Continue
 Back to Main Menu

Selecting Continue shows a screen with Game Complete! if you also collected all ../Tokens/ in all three Areas, replaced with Nice Try! if you didn't. In either case, select  or  to go back to main menu.
